column1: # lane declaration — who owns which territory, at which phase, and who outranks them.
# yields_to: comma-list of artifacts that outrank this one on THEIR territory, or -
# Three rows, all `any`: a command can be about to run in every phase, so none of these
# is a phase step. The hook is the gate; the command is its dry-run; the skill is what
# the model reads once the hook has spoken. approaches:consult-remind nudges at PROMPT time on
# irreversible tokens — a second opinion, not a block — so the territories are distinct

column5: PreToolUse on Bash or an MCP shell/SQL tool whose command classifies deny (migrate:fresh, DROP DATABASE, docker compose down -v, terraform destroy, a cp/mv/tee or key:generate over a live .env, a cd into a missing absolute dir whose chain ends in ;) or ask (git reset --hard, rm -rf ./dir, kubectl delete pod), a Write replacing an existing .env, or a Write/Edit aimed at the guard's own allow-file
invoked as /command-guard:check <command>; a command was just denied and the reason needs unpacking, or the project allow-file is being tuned
a shell command about to run can destroy data (db reset or migration, rm -rf, git history rewrite, volume removal, cloud or cluster delete), or command-guard has just denied one
a Write/Edit targets an existing linter, type-checker, test, hook or CI config file (tsconfig, eslintrc, pyproject, phpstan, hooks.json)
